item.title: EplayerX 1.2.52
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 首页新增 Trakt「今日更新」，可快速查看当天更新的剧集，并支持调整显示位置。 - 改进 Plex 合集、智能合集和首页内容的浏览、排序与分页，并同步账号授权信息。 - 加快播放器启动，减少短暂的加载提示闪烁，改进拖动进度和缩略图显示。 - 改进 Silo 外挂字幕识别与恢复，提升资源版本选择和音视频规格标识的准确性。 - 改进多窗口内容刷新与首页管理的稳定性。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本。请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Added Trakt Today’s Updates to Home for quick access to episodes airing today, with customizable placement. - Improved browsing, sorting, and pagination for Plex collections, smart collections, and Home content, with account authorization syncing. - Faster player startup, less brief loading-indicator flicker, and improved seeking and thumbnail behavior. - Improved Silo external subtitle detection and restoration, resource version selection, and audio/video format labels. - Improved reliability of content refresh across windows and Home customization.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
